entries.name: Ancient Apparition
lines: Ice Blast completely nullifies any healing, making Necrophos unable to stay in a teamfight to sustain his teammates (and himself) or deal gradual damage to the enemy, else he be faced with a quick death if focused on.

entries.name: Pugna
lines: Nether Ward causes Death Pulse to actually damage Necrophos rather than heal him. Meanwhile, Reaper Scythe's gigantic mana cost while Necrophos is near the Nether Ward can often instantly kill him.

Nether Blast and Life Drain both make quick work of Necrophos's small healthpool, especially during Ghost Shroud. The latter also makes him an unappealing target for Reaper's Scythe, and can often force Necrophos to use it defensively as he has no other means of interrupting his channeling.

entries.name: Silencer
lines: Arcane Curse punishes Necrophos if tries to spam Death Pulse, increasing the duration of the slow and damage taken over time.
Last Word heavily damages Necrophos and also silence him for a lenghty duration.

Glaives of Wisdom will reduce temporarily Necrophos intelligence on each hit dealing hindering his ability to spam Death Pulse, also reducing his attack damage and mana pool; dealing increasing amounts of phisical and pure damage each time. Silencer will permanently steal Necrophos intelligence if Necrophos is killed by him or if he dies nears him.
Global Silence turns Necrophos almost useless for a long time, allowing Silencer and his team to easily dispatch him, since Necrohpos heavily relies on his spells to survive.

entries.name: Nyx Assassin
lines: The huge physical damage taken from Vendetta will force Necrophos to use Ghost Shroud, which is good for a followup with Dagon and Ethereal Blade, both of which are common items on Nyx Assassin.
Using Ghost Shroud also sets Necrophos up for a Mind Flare or Impale.

entries.name: Dazzle
lines: Dazzle's Shadow Wave is a spammable healing ability that spreads around his entire team, slowing the death of his teammates as effectively as Necrophos spreads damage to them.
If not immediately, Shallow Grave delays his ally from gradually dying to Necrophos's abilities, especially Reaper's Scythe.

However, bear in mind that Dazzle's Poison Touch, Shadow Wave and Bad Juju all deal physical damage, and Dazzle has no abilities to help him deal magical damage at all, which can cause problems for Dazzle to kill Necrophos if he uses Ghost Shroud to protect himself.

entries.name: Lina
lines: Laguna Blade's damage as well as damage from all of Lina's abilities will be greatly amplified during Ghost Shroud.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Even though Luna has a hard time laning against Necrophos, his Ghost Shroud won’t protect him in teamfights because it will increase the damage from Lucent Beam and Eclipse.
Luna is a natural Black King Bar wielder, and none of Necrophos's spells can bypass spell immunity outside of Heartstopper Aura.

entries.name: Lion
lines: Mana Drain depletes Necrophos's mana pool, preventing him from using his abilities.
Finger of Death deals high magical damage, which becomes amplified by Ghost Shroud.

entries.name: Meepo
lines: Necrophos struggles at clearing away durable illusions or summons. Meepo can overwhelm Necrophos with his many duplicates, especially in the later stages of the game, and his Earthbind will prevent Necrophos from getting away, even if he casts Ghost Shroud.
Meepo's high burst damage from Poof can make it difficult for to Necrophos to stay alive, and as Necrophos excels in extended fights, he will not be able to do as much damage as he intends to.

entries.name: Oracle
lines: During the laning stage, Oracle's Purifying Flames nullifies any damage that Heartstopper Aura might inflict.
Fate's Edict and False Promise can protect an ally from Reaper's Scythe.
Oracle can dispel Ghost Shroud with Fortune's End.

entries.name: Outworld Destroyer
lines: Outworld Destroyer is not exceptionally dangerous to Necrohpos because of his Ghost Shroud, but his Astral Imprisonment can save his allies from Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe, though only if he uses it at the right time, If an Outworld Destroyer is nearby, Necrophos should not use Reaper's Scythe unless he has banished himself, or has banished two heroes within 15 seconds

entries.name: Phantom Lancer
lines: Diffusal Blade is a core item on Phantom Lancer. And when combined with his numerous illusions, it allows him to rapidly deplete Necrophos's mana, rendering Necrophos incapable of doing anything.
It can be difficult to single out the true Phantom Lancer among his army, giving Necrophos a hard time with aiming his ultimate.
Even if his illusions are defeated, Phantom Lancer can simply create more of them at his disposal with almost no issues.

entries.name: Rubick
lines: If Rubick steals Reaper's Scythe, he can turn the powerful ultimate back against Necrophos's team. Even his other spells are useful in Rubick's hands, giving him a sustain or a weak initiation/protection tool.

entries.name: Shadow Demon
lines: Disruption can save an ally from a fatal Reaper's Scythe.
Demonic Purge can remove Ghost Shroud, making Necrophos vulnerable to physical damage and preventing him from regenerating health.

entries.name: Ursa
lines: Ursa can do damage very fast with his Overpower and Fury Swipes abilities, Necrohops will have taken large amounts of damage before he can use Ghost Shroud, And if Ursa has Skull Basher, Ursa will quickly demolish Necrophos before he can do anything to retaliate.

Skilled and smart Ursa can bait Necrophos into using Reaper's Scythe on him, and with his Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Enrage that can negate 80% of the damage, Ursa will often survive and waste Reaper's Scythe.

entries.name: Viper
lines: Viper does large amounts of magic damage over time, meaning that if a Necrophos uses Ghost Shroud, Viper's abilities will greatly reduce Necrophos survivability, and may actually kill him.

By the same token, Viper can use his Viper Strike on Necrophos if he attempts to heal himself with Ghost Shroud, and depending on any other effects Necrophos may have from him, (IE: Poison Attack, Corrosive Skin), Viper can often kill Necrophos while he is in his Ghost Shroud.
Viper's Corrosive Skin helps him take reduced damage from all of Necrophos spells that deal magical damage, which is his only source of damage.

entries.name: Wraith King
lines: Using Reaper's Scythe against Wraith King is a bad idea for Necrophos as his Reincarnation can waste it. And when upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter it can delay the deaths of allies.
Heroes who possess abilities that can save targets from being killed by Reaper's Scythe: Abaddon, Bane, Outworld Destroyer, Shadow Demon, Omniknight, etc.
Any disable, silence or mana burn is a good way to nullify Necrophos, as he is slow and has little offensive presence or self defense without his spells.
Illusions make it difficult for Necrophos to target his Reaper's Scythe correctly, thus giving illusion heroes like Holy Knight or Naga Siren an edge against Necrophos.

Enemies that possess high defenses through magic resistance, damage reduction, or high regeneration will make it difficult to whittle their health down to get to Reaper's Scythe's threshold. Such heroes include Bristleback (although only from behind), Spectre, Ursa, and Fairy Knight.
Silences are a problem to Necrophos as he mainly relies on his abilities to survive: Gust, Doom, Global Silence, Smoke Screen, Blood Rite.
Spirit Vessel prevents Necrophos from getting too much health from his abilities.
Shiva's Guard provides an aura that reduces all heals and regen.
Nullifier renders Ghost Shroud completely ineffective during its duration.

Revenant's Brooch lets attackers deal magical damage, and to attack ethereal units, which can Necrophos's Ghost Shroud, his only defense ability against him and make him weak even against heroes he naturally counters.

Glimmer Cape can be used to greatly reduce the damage from Reaper's Scythe. Since Necrophos tends to use Reaper's Scythe when his target is just below at half health, the extra magical resistance is usually enough to survive.

Eul's Scepter of Divinity dispels the Ghost Shroud form and provides extra control while its upgrade Wind Waker can also be used on an ally during the stun of Reaper's Scythe to save them, Wind Waker also allows allies to move when casted on them.
Eye of Skadi hinders Necrophos's already poor mobility and greatly reduces his regeneration.

Lotus Orb reflects Reaper's Scythe back to Necrophos. Most of the time his Reaper's Scythe will not kill him back as he'd be casting it mostly at full health, but it does mean Necrophos will be stunned through spell immunity for 1.5 seconds, preventing him from possibly following up his ultimate with more of his own damage.
Linken's Sphere makes it impossible to cast Reaper's Scythe on a target if there are no other abilities that can waste it.
Black King Bar ignores the damage from any of Necrophos's abilities, especially Reaper's Scythe.
Orchid Malevolence and Bloodthorn prevents Necrophos from spamming Death Pulse, preventing him from healing back and/or retaliating, and Ghost Shroud to defend himself.

Scythe of Vyse is a stronger counter than the above mentioned items, preventing not only his abilities from being cast, but also his items that could either heal him further, dispel the debuffs, or help him escape.
Silver Edge disables Heartstopper Aura, which reduces his presence in fights. But remember that already existing stacks of Heartstopper Aura still provide bonus health and mana regeneration.
Dagon can deal massive damage to Necrophos massive damage if he tries to use Ghost Shroud to defend himself, and when combined with Ethereal Blade Necrophos get mostly killed in only few seconds.
Diffusal Blade can be activated to slow down Necrophos, while allowing the user's attacks to burn Necrophos's mana.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Frequent healing from Death Pulse makes it difficult for Axe to finish off targets with Culling Blade.
Reaper's Scythe negates Axe's tankiness, and can kill him quickly after initiation if Axe's health is low enough.
Heartstopper Aura can be very effective against Axe due to Axe's high strength gain.

However, bear in mind that Berserker's Call can prevent Necrophos from using his Ghost Shroud to defend his fragile self from physical damages. And Heartstopper Aura can unintentionally help Axe to trigger his Counter Helix more frequently while also hurting Necrophos with Blade Mail during activation.

entries.name: Bristleback
lines: Heartstopper Aura deals percentage-based damage flagged as HP removal, so it is not reduced by Bristleback, nor does it trigger passive Quill Sprays.

Reaper's Scythe is very effective against Bristleback not only due to its percentage-based damage, but rather because it first stuns and then deals its damage, allowing Necrophos to position in front of Bristleback in time.

entries.name: Huskar
lines: Huskar is often at low health, making him easy prey for Reaper's Scythe.
Ghost Shroud prevents Huskar from stacking Burning Spear, and if Heartstopper Aura stacks are active, can regenerate health lost to existing stacks.

entries.name: Phoenix
lines: Phoenix constantly depletes its own health due to the health costs of its abilities. Unlike heroes that have a similar mechanic, Phoenix does not benefit from low health, nor does it really have a countermeasure for it. As such, Phoenix is a very vulnerable target for Necrophos to prey on, especially when caught off guard before it can cast Supernova.

entries.name: Pudge
lines: No matter how high Pudge builds up strength with his Flesh Heap, all it needs is for him to fall below a certain percentage of health for him to fall to Reaper's Scythe. Considering his constant self-damage with Rot, being around Heartstopper Aura will prove risky for an overconfident Pudge.

entries.name: Sven
lines: His Heartstopper Aura deals the same gradual damage over time no matter how high Sven builds his strength or health pool up, and should he fall down to a certain percentage, his high health will no longer matter if Necrophos manages to land his Reaper's Scythe, killing him instantly. But it is best if Necrophos can either catch him off guard before he can possibly use his Black King Bar (which is an item Sven players commonly purchase), or bait him out of it.
Ghost Shroud prevents Sven from hitting Necrophos, and if he doesn't have his Storm Hammer available, it could make him completely immune to Sven and allow Necrophos to easily kite him around.

entries.name: Tidehunter
lines: No matter how Tidehunter builds tanky items such as (Guardian Greaves, Crimson Guard or Pipe of Insight), all it needs is for him to fall below a certain percentage of health for him to fall to Reaper's Scythe.

Carries are a prime target for his ultimate, as if timed properly, they will be killed before they can even have a noticeable effect in a teamfight, and be forced to stay out of the game longer due to the extended respawn time. Such heroes must be careful when engaging a team with Necrophos, as if they are too careless or lack proper protection, their reckless plays can be quickly and severely punished.
Heroes that commonly purchase Armlet of Mordiggian will be unable to use it effectively under the effects of a maxed out Heartstopper Aura.

Heroes that have high health but little to no magic resistance are easy prey for Necrophos, as no matter how high they build their health up, Reaper's Scythe will kill them outright as long as they fall under a certain threshold, and Heartstopper Aura will deal the same amount of damage regardless, decaying their health the longer they stay within range. As such, Strength heroes like Holy Knight, Centaur Warrunner or Magnus are good targets for his ultimate.

Heroes that have escape abilities (such as Queen of Pain_new, Storm Spirit or Timbersaw) can be either nullified by Reaper's Scythe or a complimentary item for Necrophos (like Rod of Atos or Scythe of Vyse). If Necrophos is quick enough and enters range, they can quickly, if not instantly, die if they are not quick enough.

Heroes that have small health pools and little to no escape mechanisms are even easier prey for Necrophos. Ghost Shroud's slow will allow him to catch him with them, and get nuked down with his abilities, even preventing retaliation due to Reaper's Scythe's stun. Such heroes include Crystal Maiden, Witch Doctor, Warlock or Shadow Fiend.
Heroes who rely on physical damage are easily negated by Ghost Shroud: Phantom Assassin, Wraith King, Juggernaut.

entries.name: Abaddon
lines: The sustain and strong dispel from Abaddon helps keep Necrophos alive longer in fights, allowing a huge damage swing from healing, damage, and massive health removal from Heartstopper Aura.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Axe's initiation allows him to both catch and severely damage multiple enemies at once. Counter Helix's pure damage quickly removes a chunk of health from nearby enemies, making Necrophos' presence more potent.
Both of their ultimates are instant kills when fallen below a certain threshold of health. If the enemy team is not careful, they could be very easily wiped from the field without retaliation.

entries.name: Earthshaker
lines: Earthshaker's initiation allows him to both catch and severely damage multiple enemies at once, from Echo Slam removes a chunk of health from nearby enemies, making Necrophos' presence more potent.

entries.name: Legion Commander
lines: A Duel will be very swiftly ended by Necrophos' nukes. If it ends during Reaper's Scythe, the Dueled enemy will also face an extended respawn time, making these two a formidable pair in a teamfight.

entries.name: Oracle
lines: Combined with Ghost Shroud, Fate's Edict renders Necrophos immune to physical damage and attacks, and immune to magical damage, at the sole cost of being (doubly) disarmed. Furthermore, while Ghost Shroud can be dispelled by an opponent's ability or item, Fate's Edict cannot since it is considered a debuff.
Purifying Flames helps Necrophos sustain in fights, and the healing is further amplified by Ghost Shroud.
False Promise can save Necrophos. If it can buy him enough time to use Reaper's Scythe and a couple of other spells or a wand usage, odds are Necrophos will heal back to full HP after the Promise.

entries.name: Pugna
lines: Decrepify increases the damage Reaper's Scythe does, allowing Necrophos to kill enemies even quicker.
His great teamfight abilities like Nether Blast and Nether Ward help damage multiple units all at once, making Necrophos' presence even deadlier.
Any hero with great nuking power will work well with Necrophos. Such heroes include Lina, Lion, Shadow Fiend, and Thor.

Heroes with high damage in a large area of effect will help make Necrophos a deadly foe for the enemy team, as they would all be more vulnerable to his Heartstopper Aura or be possible targets for his ultimate. Heroes like Phoenix, Enigma, Jakiro, even Radiance wielders like Spectre or Alchemist will aid him greatly in a teamfight.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch improves Necrophos's early stats as well as damage and can be built into a Magic Wand later on.

entries.name: Clarity
lines: Clarity to keep being able to cast Death Pulse when needed.

entries.name: Mantle of Intelligence
lines: Mantle of Intelligence gives a little boost to Necrophos' mana pool and damage.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango helps Necrophos stay in the lane.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve for quick regeneration of health.

entries.name: Faerie Fire
lines: Faerie Fire helps Necrophos' somewhat low base damage and clutch heal if running mid.

entries.name: Bracer
lines: Bracer is an alternative early stat item that makes Necrophos hardier, letting him survive longer to chip away at enemies.

entries.name: Null Talisman
lines: Null Talisman gives cheap attributes and a bit of extra damage output to give Necrophos an edge in lane.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots will allow Necrophos to replenish his mana in conjunction with his innate regen, as well as replenishing the mana of nearby allies. Later it can be upgraded into Guardian Greaves that can do the same, and which can also heal nearby allies and apply a basic dispel on Necrophos.

entries.name: Veil of Discord
lines: Veil of Discord is a good early-mid game item, and will amplify Necrophos's spell damage, as well as increasing armor for durability. Later it can be upgraded into Shiva's Guard that can do the same while also allowing Necrophos to reduce heals, lifesteal and attack speed of enemy heroes.

entries.name: Blade Mail
lines: Blade Mail punishes enemies for focusing on Necrophos, pairing well with his regeneration and Death Pulse to outlast enemies.

entries.name: Boots of Travel
lines: Boots of Travel gives excellent mobility to help maneuver through fights and farm or push multiple lanes.

entries.name: Radiance
lines: Radiance synergizes well with Heartstopper Aura. Acquiring it will strengthen Necrophos's presence during teamfights and help keep your lanes clear of enemy creeps.

entries.name: Dagon
lines: Dagon provides good stats and spell lifesteal to keep Necrophos in the fight. Energy Burst can either lower a target's health for a Reaper's Scythe kill or deal a finishing blow when Reaper's Scythe is on cooldown, while also being a burst heal. Dagon combined with the Radiance can allow Necrophos to rapidly heal himself while damaging enemies around himself. Dagon can also help Necrophos pop Linken's Sphere, and put it on a cooldown before using Reaper's Scythe.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard will give Necrophos access to Death Seeker, that can allow Necrophos to close the gap on enemies by turning into a large Death Pulse that can spread towards nearby enemies and allies once it arrives to the targeted location.

entries.name: Shiva's Guard
lines: Shiva's Guard's aura will slow the enemy's attack, while its active ability places a slowing debuff on enemies.

entries.name: Scythe of Vyse
lines: Scythe of Vyse gives good attributes and mana regeneration. Its disable makes it easier to kill a powerful carry or an annoying support/initiator.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar blocks incoming disables to let Necrophos stay in the fight for longer and spam his abilities.

entries.name: Aghanim's Scepter
lines: Aghanim's Scepter will give Necrophos nice attributes, and will also greatly increase the impact of Heartstopper Aura for 50% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

entries.name: Eternal Shroud
lines: Eternal Shroud is an alternative upgrade for Cloak that sustains Necrophos' mana pool against spell damage, if your team already has a Pipe of Insight holder.

entries.name: Guardian Greaves
lines: Guardian Greaves gives Necrophos a powerful burst heal, mana restoration and a basic dispel, especially when paired with Ghost Shroud, which can help him stay alive for longer and allow him to support his team further.

entries.name: Force Staff
lines: Force Staff is usually passed up in favor of Aghanim's Shard, which does not occupy an inventory slot, but can be used as an escape tool for yourself or allies if needed against high-mobility foes.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger is useful for Necrophos when he wants to initiate on enemies or chase down fleeing foes. Later it can be upgraded either into Arcane Blink in the late game for extra teamfight impact, heal and mana restoration, or into Overwhelming Blink that can damage and severely slow down enemy heroes.

entries.name: Ethereal Blade
lines: Ethereal Blade will give Necrophos good attributes, mana regeneration and extra cast range, allowing him to use his abilities from further distances. And it will also allow Necrophos to disarm enemy heroes and make them more vulnerable to his magical damage output, as well as giving him another way to defend himself against enemy heroes who rely on direct attacks to be effective.

entries.name: Revenant's Brooch
lines: Revenant's Brooch will give Necrophos spell lifesteal with which he can heal himself by damaging enemies with his abilities, very good damage output. And will also allow Necrophos's attacks to deal magical damage that can ignore armor and attack ethereal units, giving Necrophos another way of dealing damage to Ethereal units.

entries.name: Rod of Atos
lines: Rod of Atos wille give Necrophos health, intelligence, and a long-range root with a short cooldown, all valuable assets for Necrophos. Later it can be upgraded into Gleipnir that can give Necrophos a good group disable and Chain Lightning allows you to clear creep waves and neutral camps extremely fast with Death Pulse.

entries.name: Spirit Vessel
lines: Spirit Vessel is also a nice item choice. It gives increased health, some extra stats, and mana regeneration; the active Soul Release has really good synergy with Necrophos's skillset since it deals damage based on current health and reduces enemy regeneration and healing, paired with death pulse and Hearthstoper Aura, you can bring down a hero to the Reaper's Scythe threshold in a few seconds. The item also can be used to heal yourself or allies.

entries.name: Pipe of Insight
lines: Pipe of Insight gives much more health regeneration and increases magic resistance, most especially to counter the magic vulnerability while under the effects of Ghost Shroud.

entries.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
lines: Eul's Scepter of Divinity can be used both defensively and as a disable, while giving good mana regeneration and movement speed. Later it can be upgraded into Wind Waker, a very strong defensive and escaping item that can also be used to save allies.

entries.name: Octarine Core
lines: Octarine Core shortens the cooldowns of Necrophos's abilities, allowing him to spam Death Pulse and Death Seeker to heal allies and damage enemies more often.

entries.name: Kaya and Sange
lines: Kaya and Sange improves Necrophos's teamfight presence by amplifying his considerable regeneration while giving extra health, debuff resistance, and spell damage.

pros: Powerful nuke in Reaper's Scythe, especially against heroes below 40% hp.
Strong against high hp hero like Pudge and Axe
playstyle.text: Necrophos is a strong nuker and tanky hero who is capable of surviving long teamfights and picking off key enemy heroes with Reaper's Scythe. His Death Pulse is able to heal/damage allies/enemies, Ghost Shroud is able to chase fleeing heroes, and Heartstopper Aura helps harrass enemies in early game. Depending on the build, Necrophos can be either heavy nuker, or durable caster.
cons: Less effective against heroes with Spell Immunity, Magic Resistance and Silence.

lines: Necrophos is effective when he stands in the middle of a fight. The focus of the build is to spam Death Pulse and help teammates to stay alive. Mekansm and Arcane Boots are common items for offlane Necrophos. Necrophos should never be the center of attention as he is naturally squishy and can only out survive his opponents when a fight is dragged long enough. The build is effective for early 4-5 man pushing. Durable Caster is standard build for Necrophos and should be used as the first step of playing Necrophos before considering other styles.

Necrophos can sometimes be played as a nuker, starting in midlane and building item like Dagon and Ethereal Blade. Necrophos can nuke an important target with Reaper's Scythe > Ethereal Blade > Dagon > Death Pulse combo (Note: Reaper's Scythe has 1.5 second delay before damaging the target. Thus, all abilities cast after Reaper's Scythe must be fit within this time window). A Heavy Nuker Necrophos can be very aggressive but also extremely squishy as his only way to survive is to make use of Death Pulse by killing his opponents as fast as he can.

Necrophos can thrive in all three lanes, but is most commonly played as a midlaner, where it is safer to push the lane with Death Pulse and he can secure many levels and farm. The offlane can work if the matchup is highly favorable, or with an aggressive support. Safelane Necrophos is a niche pick that typically works well with early game deathball pushes but is perfectly viable if your other lanes can compensate for other damage types.

Necrophos is strong in laning stage because of his Death Pulse and Heartstopper Aura passives. Successfully denying or last hitting to accrue Heartstopper Aura stacks while keeping the enemy in range of Heartstopper will gradually swing the lane in your favor.
Necrophos is prone to ganks. Make sure not to overextend, and avoid prematurely using Ghost Shroud against magical nukers.
Prioritize the enemy carry or mid when using Reaper's Scythe.

When teamfighting as Necrophos, you should aim to gradually swing the teamfight in your favor. After shutting out key enemy heroes with your Scythe, use your powerful regeneration (from Death Pulse stacks and Ghost Shroud) to surprise your enemies with a large heal. Your goal is to stay alive for as long as possible, in order to maximize Heartstopper, gather Heartstopper aura stacks, and heal your allies. This is also why your late game itemisation should include ample survivability.
In laning stage, Death Pulse is good for both harassing enemy hero and securing last hits.
Though Death Pulse has high mana cost, Necrophos can use it often in the early game to last hit and get mana regeneration from Heartstopper Aura.
Using Death Pulse will cancel Town Portal Scroll channeling.
After obtaining a mana regeneration item, Death Pulse can keep your allies and creeps healthy, which is especially important for pushing with a group.
Remember that Death Pulse is able to target invisible units. If you believe you are near an unseen enemy, don't be afraid to use it, as its skulls may locate their position.
Use Ghost Shroud when near death to amplify any healing, such as Death Pulse stacks and Mekansm. It is extremely potent when combined with a Magic Wand, provided it has enough stacks.

When being ganked by the enemy, use your Magic Wand stacks right after activating Ghost Shroud to greatly amplify both the HP and mana you've received. This will allow to turn the tides of the battle.
Use Ghost Shroud to chase down enemy heroes, provided they won't turn around on you with burst magical damage.
As Ghost Shroud negates physical damage, use it when expecting physical burst damage, such as Boundless Strike, or when diving towers.
Be sensible when using Ghost Shroud.
If using Ghost Shroud purely to regenerate when not fighting, it takes 67 mana gained before Ghost Shroud's amplification to outweigh the manacost.
An early point in Heartstopper Aura will help with the laning stage.

Consider leveling up Heartstopper Aura after both Death Pulse and Ghost Shroud, as it is more effective later in the game when your adversaries have higher amounts of health. If your enemy's line-up has many naturally high health targets (e.g. strength heroes like Pudge or Centaur Warrunner), you can level it up earlier on.

The damage of Heartstopper Aura pierces spell immunity, while your other damaging abilities do not. Consider staying near and right-clicking enemies with Black King Bar activated to assist your team during a fight if the fight is in your team's favor.
At level 3, Reaper's Scythe will probably kill targets at 40% or less health. Remember to factor in magic resistance from items and abilities before you attempt to execute an enemy hero with it.
Any kill under Reaper's Scythe will be credited to Necrophos, replenishing his mana and health.
Reaper's Scythe is not a channeling ability, meaning you can move the moment you have cast it.
Secured kills from Reaper's Scythe will grant you enough Death Pulse stacks to turn around an unfavorable fight, especially in combination with Ghost Shroud.

Талант 25 уровня: «+0,5% к урону Heartstopper Aura» заменён на «+0,3 к урону за единицу недостающего здоровья от Reaper's Scythe»

notes.text: Усиление восстановления изменено с 45/55/65/75% на 55/60/65/70%

bio: В годы ужасной чумы один безвестный монах с дурными наклонностями по имени Ротунд'йер неожиданно для себя занял пост кардинала: все другие претенденты на должность скоропостижно скончались. В то время как другие братья-монахи облегчали участь больных, новоиспечённый кардинал заседал в Соборе Румуска, обещая умирающим богачам духовное вознаграждение, коли те передадут свои земли их ордену. Со временем чума угасла, оставив лишь пару неуступчивых очагов, а на деяния Ротунд'йера обратила внимание высшая власть. Бывшего кардинала обвинили в ереси и отрядили ухаживать за чумными, где его медленно и мучительно пожрала бы болезнь. Но судьи не учли, что чума стала Ротунд'йеру родной. Хворь вошла в тело монаха — но не убила, а стала кормить его силы и превратила в сущего чумного мага, Епископа мора. Теперь он ходит по земле, распространяя свою эпидемию, и мощь его растёт с каждой деревней, сгинувшей в его губительном присутствии.
trivia: Реплика героя «My name is legion!» возможно отсылает к одному из посланий Марка под номером 5:9 которая читается в NIV библии, т.е обновлённой. «Тогда Иисус спросил его, как тебя зовут?» «меня зовут Легион», ответил он, «ибо нас много».
Реплика героя «You reap what you sow.» может отсылаться к посланию к Галатам 6:7 «Не обманывайте, ибо Бог не может быть обманут. Вы пожинаете то, что садите»
Реплика героя «Red Death.» может быть отсылкой к одноимённому короткому рассказу Эдгара Аллана По.
Альтернативное имя героя в оригинальной Dota было «A Phoe Gyi», что означает «старик» на Бирманском языке. Это также звучит похоже на «a fogey», то есть пожилого, обычно сварливого человека.

Изначальное имя героя звучало как «Necrophiliac» что можно перевести как «некрофил», но создатель героя поменял ему имя на «Necrolyte» (от греческого «некрос» — что означает труп, псаломщик, религиозный служитель) после осознания, что имя содержит сексуальный подтекст.

notes.text: При применении Death Pulse прерывает произносимые заклинания Necrophos.
Волна летит со скоростью 400 единиц.
Действует на невидимых существ и существ в тумане войны.
Не действует на неуязвимых и спрятанных существ.
Действует на курьеров: лечит союзного курьера, но не наносит урон вражескому.
Во время действия Ghost Shroud лечит Necrophos на следующие значения на каждом уровне:

notes: Снаряд этой способности нельзя сбить с цели.
abilities.lore: Ротунд'йер не тратит души несчастных чумных понапрасну.
abilities.description: Герой выпускает вокруг себя волну смерти, которая наносит урон врагам и исцеляет союзников.
abilities.name: Death Pulse

notes.text: При применении прерывает произносимые заклинания Necrophos.
Применяет к Necrophos призрачную форму, обезоруживая его, делая его неуязвимым к атакам и давая 100% сопротивление к физическому урону.
Снижает общее сопротивление магии Necrophos до 6,25%, учитывая его базовое сопротивление в 25% и не учитывая другие источники сопротивления.
Сочетается мультипликативно с другими источниками сопротивления магии.
Уменьшение сопротивления магии не сочетается с уменьшениями других призрачных форм, будет действовать уменьшение с наибольшим значением.
Применяет усиление лечения, регенерации здоровья, восстановления и регенерации маны, но не усиление вампиризма или вампиризма заклинаний.
Замедление представлено в виде ауры. Дебафф задерживается на 0,5 сек.

abilities.lore: Душами своих жертв Ротунд'йер стирает грань между жизнью и смертью.
abilities.description: Герой проникает в мир усопших, замедляя врагов вокруг. В этом облике он не может атаковать, получает повышенный магический урон, но защищён от физических атак и быстрее восстанавливает свои здоровье и ману.
abilities.name: Ghost Shroud

notes.text: Дебафф от Heartstopper Aura задерживается на 0,5 сек.
Потеря здоровья от Heartstopper Aura — это отнимающий здоровье урон, поэтому на него не срабатывают любые эффекты, реагирующие на урон.
Урон можно увеличить понижением сопротивления магии цели, но на него не действует усиление урона заклинаний.
Наносит 0,12%/0,24%/0,36%/0,48% (0,22%/0,34%/0,46%/0,58%) от максимального здоровья существа в качестве урона с интервалом в 0,2, начиная спустя 0,2 секунды после изучения способности.

Выбор увеличивающего потерю здоровья в секунду таланта не увеличит урон по противникам, если они уже находятся под действием ауры. Для обновления значений им нужно потерять эффект ауры и снова его получить.
Иконка дебаффа показывается врагам в случае, если у затронутого существа есть обзор на Necrophos.
Однако цифры урона видны всегда.
Не действует на древних крипов.
Necrophos получает заряд за каждое совершенное убийство, включая добивание союзных существ, но исключая убийство иллюзий и Tempest Double.
Каждый заряд действует независимо от других. Они не обновляются при появлении нового, но делят между собой иконку в строке эффектов. Текущее число зарядов видно в иконке.
Каждый заряд восстанавливает до 32/40/48/56 (44/55/66/77) единиц здоровья и маны за всю длительность.
Убийство героя добавляет сразу 6 зарядов, которые восстанавливают до 192/240/288/336 (264/330/396/462) здоровья и маны за всю длительность.
Во время действия Ghost Shroud восстанавливает Necrophos следующие значения на каждом уровне:

Снижающий восстановления здоровья у жертв талант лишь добавляет к Heartstopper Aura эффект уменьшения восстановления здоровья, но не уменьшение лечения, уменьшение вампиризма или уменьшение вампиризма заклинаний.
С [[ File:Aghanim's Scepter icon.png
Подводя итог, наносит 1,2%/2,4%/3,6%/4,8% (2,2%/3,4%/4,6%/5,8%) от максимального здоровья существа каждую секунду, пока Necrophos находится под действием Ghost Shroud.

notes: Урон не запрещает использовать такие предметы, как Blink Dagger.
abilities.lore: Дерзнувших приблизиться к Ротунд`йеру окутывает дух мора и чумы.
abilities.scepter: К уменьшению здоровья добавляется 50% от текущего восстановления здоровья владельца.
abilities.description: Герой останавливает сердца врагов вокруг, отчего они постепенно теряют часть максимального здоровья.
abilities.name: Heartstopper Aura

notes.text: Требуется [[ File:Aghanim's Shard icon.png
Нельзя применить на себя.
Снаряд летит со скоростью 900.
Death Seeker сначала накладывает дебафф, затем применяет Death Pulse.
Делает цель бесплотной, обезоруживая её и давая иммунитет к атакам и 100% физическое сопротивление.
Уменьшение сопротивления магии не сочетается с уменьшениями других призрачных форм, будет действовать уменьшение с наибольшим значением.
Снижает сопротивление магии большинства героев до 6,25%.
Сочетается мультипликативно с другими источниками сопротивления магии.
Применяет Death Pulse текущего уровня. Действуют те же примечания, что и для Death Pulse.
Если Death Pulse не изучена, то при применении снаряд не выпустится, мана потратится и начнется перезарядка.
Если цель при попадании снаряда неуязвима или спрятана, то Death Pulse не выпустится.
Death Pulse наносит 125/200/275/350 урона каждому врагу, который попал в целевой радиус.

abilities.lore: Приверженцы Рамаска считают, что Ротунд'йер — скорее чума, чем человек.
abilities.description: Герой превращается в большой снаряд, летящий в местоположение указанного существа. Долетев, снаряд применит Death Pulse на врагов и союзников вокруг.
abilities.name: Death Seeker

abilities.description: Убив любое существо, владелец способности на 8 сек. получает складывающийся эффект, увеличивающий восстановление здоровья и маны. За убийство героя даётся сразу несколько эффектов.
abilities.name: Sadist

notes.text: Может быть использовано на иллюзии и крипов-героев.
Урон рассчитывается и наносится в конце действия оглушения.
Наносит достаточно урона для убийства героя (до уменьшений), если у цели максимум 41%/44%/47% от её здоровья.
C Death Seeker Reaper's Scythe наносит достаточно урона для убийства героя, если у цели осталось 51%/56%/59% от её здорвовья.
Убийство под эффектом этой способности засчитывает как убийство, совершенное Necrophos.
Если выбранное существо было убито союзником, то убийство не считается за добивание — убийцей будет Necrophos.

Имеет приоритет ниже, чем у Ice Blast. Если выбранная цель умирает от раскола Ice Blast, убийство не будет приписано Necrophos, если только он не оказался причиной, из-за которой произошел взрыв цели.
Имеет приоритет выше, чем Winter's Curse. Если на цель действуют оба эффекта, то убийство будет засчитано Necrophos.
Necrophos получает постоянный эффект, если убийство было засчитано ему.
Получает эффект, даже если цель имела возможность воскреснуть. Получает эффект от иллюзии, крипов-героев, но нет от копии Tempest Double.
Число эффектов показано на иконке баффа. Текущий бонус к восстановлению здоровья и маны указан в описании этого эффекта.
При повышении уровня Reaper's Scythe все накопленные эффекты не адаптируются под новые значения, а остаются прежними.
Длительность оглушения не взаимодействует с сопротивлением эффектам.

abilities.lore: Смерть и страдания, витающие в воздухе, усиливают чумную магию Ротунд'йера.
abilities.description: Оглушает выбранного вражеского героя, а затем наносит ему урон, пропорциональный отсутствующему у него здоровью. Убийство врага под действием этой способности засчитывается её владельцу и навсегда увеличивает ему восстановление здоровья и маны.
abilities.name: Reaper's Scythe

hype: Necrophos всюду несёт благополучие друзьям и смерть — врагам. Излечивая союзников и нанося противникам урон каждым пульсом смерти, он изничтожает врагов одним лишь своим присутствием. Также Necrophos может воззвать к помощи самого жнеца, который надолго задержит жертву в мире ином.
name: Necrophos
short: Одновременно лечит союзников и наносит урон врагам

talents.left: –20% к восст. здоровья у жертв Heartstopper Aura

talents.right: +0.3 к урону за единицу здоровья от Reaper's Scythe
